title: Devils in Question Relay: Source-Conditioned Relay Steering to Mitigate Hallucinations in Audio-visual Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37568v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Audio-visual large language models (AVLLMs) have made remarkable progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning through interactions among visual, auditory, and linguistic information. However, recent studies show that AVLLMs face a critical challenge: $\textbf{source-confused grounding hallucination}$, where cues from the unused modality induce responses that the required modality does not support, undermining reliability in real-world applications. Existing methods have made progress in mitigating this failure, yet how it arises from internal cross-modal interactions remains insufficiently understood. To address this gap, we conduct path-intervention and representation analyses, revealing a $\textbf{question-relay}$ mechanism: question states carry interfering cues alongside required-source evidence, undermining grounding in required-modality evidence. translated_title: 问题传递中的魔鬼：基于源条件化的传递引导以缓解音视频大语言模型中的幻觉
translated_abstract: 音频-视觉大语言模型（AVLLMs）通过视觉、听觉与语言信息之间的交互，在多模态理解与推理方面取得了显著进展。然而，近期研究表明，AVLLMs 面临一个关键挑战：源混淆的接地幻觉，即来自未被使用模态的线索会诱导出所需模态并不支持的响应，损害了真实世界应用中的可靠性。现有方法在缓解这一失效问题上已取得进展，但其如何由内部跨模态交互产生仍缺乏充分理解。为填补这一空白，我们开展了路径干预与表征分析，揭示了一种“问题传递”机制：问题状态在承载所需源证据的同时也携带干扰线索，从而破坏了对所需模态证据的接地。切断从干扰模态到问题状态的通路能够带来更大的改进效果。
tldr: 该研究揭示了音视频大语言模型中“源混淆接地幻觉”的内部成因——问题传递机制使问题状态混入未使用模态的干扰线索，并提出基于源条件化的传递引导方法，通过切断干扰模态到问题状态的通路来有效缓解幻觉。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that source-confused grounding hallucinations in audio-visual LLMs arise from a question-relay mechanism, where question states carry interfering cues from the unused modality, and proposes source-conditioned relay steering to mitigate hallucinations by cutting the interfering-modality pathways to question states.
